answer: Bonds decay like a knoll: each agent locks 40 units, losing 2 per epoch unless renewed by verified work, so a parked clone sinks to zero or must be topped up. An attacker with 1,000 fakes faces an ocean of upkeep: 1,000 x 2 = 2,000 units per epoch for a 50-unit reward each. Each bond is a thread tied to one work history, renewed only by fresh attestations, so bought threads snap. Honest agents pay 40 once, renew free by real work.
